# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::button`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Button control and its label width.

The pattern every widget follows (D2):
1. [`ButtonLook`](button.md#struct.ButtonLook), plain data for the continuous look of one frame, and [`ButtonLook::of`](button.md#method.ButtonLook.of), the
   look a discrete [`ButtonState`](button.md#struct.ButtonState) settles to;
2. [`paint`](button.md#fn.paint), which draws a look (specimen sheets call it directly);
3. [`button`](button.md#fn.button), the Painter-API function: the discrete look, `paint`, then the hit region;
4. [`Ui::button`](../ui.md#method.Ui.button), which interacts, animates each field of the look toward its settled value
   through the rows of [`HOVER`](button.md#constant.HOVER), [`PRESS`](button.md#constant.PRESS) and [`FOCUS`](button.md#constant.FOCUS), paints and emits the semantic node.

At rest the animated look equals `ButtonLook::of`, so the `Ui` draws exactly what `button` does.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/button.rs:1`

**Methods and associated items**

`impl ButtonLook`

- <a id="method.ButtonLook.of"></a>`pub fn of(theme: &Theme, kind: ButtonKind, state: ButtonState) -> ButtonLook`

  The look `state` settles to. The look of the source's dialog buttons (R4, D269): a
  primary rests on `surface_input` with a `fg_primary` label, a secondary rests clear (in the
  hover colour, so the fade has no dark middle) with a `fg_secondary` label; both take
  `surface_hover` on hover and `surface_active` pressed, with no press scale. A ghost looks
  as a secondary and also scales by [`PRESS_SCALE`](button.md#constant.PRESS_SCALE) when pressed.
